beats.text: My grandfather never spoke of it without lowering his voice. They say the tide there is colder than it should be.
Something vast sleeps in the deep: {boss}. Nobody who faced it has boasted after.
Something vast sleeps in the deep: {boss}, {danger}. Bring more than courage.
Something stirs in the deep: {boss}, {danger}. Keep your breath and your wits.
It's {distance} blocks to the {direction}, in the {biome|deep water}. You'll want a way to breathe down there. Will you dive?

accepted: Bring enchanted gear, and come back with proof.
